skills.name: craft-decompose
skills.description: Use when breaking a complex task or plan into a set of structured beads issues with dependencies: 'decompose this', 'break this down into tasks', 'plan implementation tasks'. Not for creating one task (craft-task), managing an existing epic (craft-epic), or clarifying a vague task first (craft-understand).

skills.name: craft-execute
skills.description: Use when running already-decomposed beads tasks: 'execute the tasks', 'run the ready tasks', 'implement the epic'. Dispatches isolated subagents with review checkpoints and atomic commits. Not for creating tasks (craft-decompose) or hand-operating a single task (craft-task).

skills.name: craft-park
skills.description: Use when the user wants to set an idea aside mid-task without losing focus: 'park this idea', 'park: X', 'remember to do X later', 'note for later', 'come back to this'. Creates a deferred parked-idea beads issue with context and returns to work. For listing or triaging parked ideas use craft-parked.

skills.name: craft-parked
skills.description: Use when the user wants to see or triage parked ideas: 'show parked ideas', 'list parked', 'what did I park', 'promote parked idea X', 'discard parked idea X', 'review parked ideas', 'ideas parked from task X'. For parking a new idea use craft-park.

skills.name: craft-task-commit
skills.description: Use when committing work for a beads task: 'commit this task', 'task commit', 'commit with beads context', or 'now commit' after closing a task. Gathers task context for commit-tools-commit; never creates a separate commit workflow.

skills.name: craft-understand
skills.description: Use when a task is unclear and needs structured questioning before planning: 'help me understand this task', 'what am I missing', 'clarify this task', 'interview me about this', 'before we plan, let's understand'. Produces understanding, not issues; once clear, use craft-decompose.

skills.name: craft-backlog
skills.description: Use when the user wants a dashboard or overview of all beads work: 'show the backlog', 'what's ready to work on', 'what's blocked', 'group tasks by priority', 'epic overview', 'project status/statistics'. Read-only views (overview, ready, blocked, priorities, epics) with status/priority/epic filters. Not for changing a single task (craft-task) or dependencies (craft-deps).

skills.name: craft-deps
skills.description: Use when managing blocking relationships between beads tasks: 'task A depends on B', 'B blocks A', 'add/remove dependency', 'what blocks task X', 'show dependency graph', 'visualize dependencies', 'check for circular dependencies'. Not for creating/closing tasks (craft-task) or grouping into epics (craft-epic).

skills.name: craft-epic
skills.description: Use when managing a beads epic, a group of related tasks: 'create epic X', 'add task Y to epic X', 'remove task from epic', 'epic progress', 'how far along is epic X', 'close epic X'. Not for single-task actions (craft-task), blocking relationships (craft-deps), or cross-project dashboards (craft-backlog).

skills.name: craft-task
skills.description: Use when operating on one beads task: 'create task X', 'start task X', 'mark X done', 'close task X', 'show task X', 'what task is next', '/craft-task next'. Handles create, start (in-progress + context), done (optional commit), show, and next-recommendation for a single task. Not for epics (craft-epic), dependencies (craft-deps), or whole-project dashboards (craft-backlog).

commands.name: craft-decompose
commands.description: Break a task into beads issues with dependencies. [task] [--epic] [--dry-run] [--quick]

commands.name: craft-execute
commands.description: Run decomposed tasks with subagents, review and commits. [--batch-size N] [--epic id] [--task id]

commands.name: craft-park
commands.description: Park an idea for later without losing focus. <idea> [--priority 0-4] [--tags]

commands.name: craft-task
commands.description: Create, start, finish or show one task. <subcommand> [args]

agents.description:
Executes beads CLI commands to create issues from a decomposition plan.
Use this agent when you have an approved decomposition and need to create
the actual beads issues with proper ordering and dependencies.

Reviews code quality after spec compliance passes. Checks for style,
security, error handling, and maintainability issues.

Reviews task implementations for spec compliance. Use after a subagent
completes a task to verify all requirements were met.
